Hi Jason — great to meet you virtually. I'm Mina, the SE who will run the demo. Wed Jun 9 09:00 - 10:00 PST works for us; I've tentatively held that slot on my calendar pending your confirmation.

Regarding your questions:
- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II summary + access controls extract in advance. I'll share the secure link after we confirm attendees.
- Whitelist IPs: for the hosted demo environment, please allow outbound to the following IPs (short-lived access is fine):
  * 34.219.112.45
  * 34.219.112.46
  * 52.24.89.131
  (We'll also provide a temporary API key and an allowed-origin header for the sandbox.)
- Sample data: we can run everything with a synthetic dataset — no customer PII required. If you want to test with a small anonymized CSV, we can walk through ingestion steps in the demo.

Agenda that I plan to cover (60m):
1) 5m intros + objectives
2) 20m architecture & data ingestion walkthrough
3) 20m live inference run + latency/cost discussion
4) 10m Q&A + next steps (procurement/PO details)

Attachments: network-whitelist-ips.txt, se-checklist.md — the checklist includes recommended NAT, egress rules, and a troubleshooting step list for demo time.

If Wed 9th is confirmed I'll send a calendar invite with a short attendee prep note and a link to the sandbox credentials.

Best,
